Package com.egradx.audit.web

Class EgradxAuditEndpoints

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.audit.web.EgradxAuditEndpoints
Direct Known Subclasses:
EgradxAuditController, EgradxAuditPlatformController
public abstract class EgradxAuditEndpoints extends Object
Every audit endpoint, written once. EgradxAuditController runs them for the caller's own organization; EgradxAuditPlatformController across organizations, for platform administrators. Only scope(com.egradx.audit.spi.EgradxAuditActorResolver.Actor, java.util.UUID, boolean) differs.

A record outside the caller's scope answers 404, not 403: an administrator cannot learn that another organization's records exist.

    • export

      @GetMapping(value="/events/export", produces="text/csv") public void export(EgradxAuditFilter filter, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException
      The matching records as CSV, newest first, at most egradx.audit.export.max-rows. When there were more, X-Egradx-Audit-Truncated: true says so. The export is itself recorded.

      Written on the request's own thread, not as a StreamingResponseBody: that finishes with an async dispatch, which a stateless security filter chain sees unauthenticated and denies after the response is already sent — an error in every application's log for every export.

      Throws:
      IOException
